content: Ciiga Yesu Ma Gǝtlaha
Dal ba faciya ngiigga, kaa sǝgwasǝgw kǝ Maryam Magadala, ard Maryam babba Yakub, ard Salomi kǝ tǝrshan kiyava dzuupǝg tǝ tlǝwa Yesu.
Davala faciya zǝngw ma maaka, kaa dagal kǝ iitǝr damma gǝtlah ba dlakaduur wur kǝssa.
Tǝghǝrdǝgga dagala, am nǝ iitǝr mataatakaatǝra, “War wada tlǝkkiyamarwatlǝg kǝ akuriin tuuk kǝ ghaiya gǝtli?”
Daragha ba nǝ iitǝr da vaakwahiina, dzǝgarant ba nǝ iitǝr kǝ ghǝraatǝra, kaa nǝghǝganǝgh kǝ iitǝr mbats tlǝgavarwatlǝg nǝ akuriin dagala. Akuriin ndza maanda.
Daragha ba nǝ iitǝr damma gǝtliina, kaa nǝghǝgaanǝghǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ daala zǝr tsagwatsagwan ma sǝɗav maɗǝkwa cǝhurga tǝ ghyaɓa dǝvaakaffa, kaa gǝdzǝgǝtgǝdzǝg kǝ iitǝra.
Am daala zǝrǝn taa kǝ iitǝra, “Ɓagambi kǝ ajappǝr biya. Am gata Yesu uuda nazare kwa hǝrtavǝtǝna? Abi, ciyitciiga. Maay vaakwan biya. Wan vakavaki hǝngavna nǝ iina.
Damdǝga, am tagar kǝ mbǝrzahaana, ard Bitrus, taakiya da dǝga nǝ iin tǝghǝr kǝ iitǝr damma Galili, ar da nǝghǝga vaakwah nǝ iitǝr bandkwa tagatǝr nǝ iina.”
Kaa ǝmndǝra saggal kǝ ǝnghwasahahaana, ar ɓa jappǝr dlaɓa tǝg nǝ vǝghatǝra. Tagararbi aanji ndǝwar kǝ ǝlbǝg biya, aɗaba gǝdzarǝtgǝdzǝgga. Maradamarǝg Yesu Kǝ Ghǝraan Vak Maryama [
Ciyit ba nǝ Yesu ma gǝtlah dlakadur ba wur davala faciya zǝngw ma maaka, marda kǝ ghǝraan ba zǝngw vak Maryamu Magadala, kwa lagwgharda nǝ iin kǝ shatanah uuɗiif ma vǝghaana.
Kaa daas kǝ iin tagtǝr kǝ uudahi ndzar ǝmtaɗ ba bawur dǝ iina, lii taa dzǝgwagha ar tuuga.
Cinngaraba nǝ iitǝr taakiya dǝ shifǝg nǝ Yesu, dlaɓa nǝghghanǝghǝg nǝ Maryama kǝ iina, fardghǝrǝt biya.
Maradamarǝg nǝ Yesu Kǝ Ghǝran Vak Mbǝrzah Buwa
Tǝhalakwaha, kaa mbǝɗvǝghambǝɗǝg nǝ ndzǝgana vǝgha Yesu, kaa mardamarǝg kǝ ghǝraan vak mbǝrzah buwa masarta kwa ndzar tǝ ɗuula dagal damma gǝdzǝrkǝsa.
Kaa gwiyadaas kǝ lii buna ar tagar kǝ kyalmaha, bakǝvakwaha larwalǝg kǝ fadǝghǝr tǝ ǝlbǝgiina.
Tlǝri Vǝlatǝr nǝ Yesu Kǝ Mbǝrzahaana

Tǝhalakwaha, kaa mardamarǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ ghǝran vak kǝlawa tǝmkikǝn ma sarta kwa ndzar za kaffa. Kaa cagtǝraacag kǝ iin kǝ gyi tǝghǝr kǝ maira fadghǝraatǝra ard dǝkdǝka ghǝraatǝra, aɗaba fadghǝrǝtbi dǝ lii nǝgharanǝghǝg tǝhala ciigaan biya.
Amaa taa kǝ iitǝr dlaɓa, “Damdǝg damma duni baɗǝmma, tagamtǝrtag kǝ ǝlbǝg maraw kǝ uudah dǝshiga.
Baɗǝm daddakwa fadghǝrǝtfǝga, dlaɓa ɓagvara nǝ tsuufǝgga, da tlǝkkǝnatlǝg kǝ katǝgga. Baɗǝm daddakwa fadghǝrǝt biya da vǝlǝvtǝr dlaɗa.
Wan nǝ dǝgiti da ɓag lii gata kaiya kiyava marra fadǝghǝratǝra. Ar da lagwan kǝ shatanah ma ɗaagara, ar da tagaan dlaɓa kǝ ǝlbǝg dǝ daala ghaiyaha.
Ar da kǝssǝggaan kǝ ghavalah dǝ dǝvahaatǝra. Ma hǝɓaruhǝɓǝg kǝ gurra, maay nǝ dǝgiti da ɓagtǝr nǝ iin biya. Ar da fǝgaan dlaɓa kǝ dǝvahaatǝr tǝ lii yangbiya, ar da mbǝgga.”
Kǝssavantkǝsǝg nǝ Yesu dagat damma Ghǝrazhigǝla
Tǝhala kwa tagatǝra nǝ Yaazhigǝl Yesu kǝ kwanǝn kǝ ǝlbǝga, kaa kǝsvantkǝsǝg dǝvdǝt damma ghǝrazhigǝla, ndza kǝ iin tǝ dǝvaa kaffa Daadamazhigǝla.

Kaa dagal kǝ mbǝrzahaana, kaa taa ǝlbǝg maraw kǝ iitǝr aanji takwara. Ɓagaɓag nǝ Yaazhigǝl kǝ tlǝr ǝmtaɗ dǝ iitǝra, dlaɓa mara jiira ǝlbǝgahatǝr tǝdvad dǝgaha sǝrgah kwa vǝlla jappǝr fatǝraa nǝ iin kǝ ɓaggaan ǝmtaɗ dǝ ǝlbǝgahiina.]
